en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as extreme heat continues
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and very hot conditions on Wednesday, with urban highs around 34 degrees Celsius and some New Territories areas still extremely hot.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory maintained the Very Hot Weather Warning into Wednesday, advising the public to stay alert to prolonged high temperatures.

According to the forecast updated on Tuesday evening, Wednesday would be mainly fine with a minimum of about 29 degrees in the morning. Daytime temperatures were expected to reach around 34 degrees in urban areas and two to three degrees higher in the New Territories, remaining extremely hot in some places under moderate west to southwesterly winds.

The Observatory said a southwesterly airstream would gradually affect the coast of Guangdong, with the extreme heat expected to ease slightly later in the week. More showers were forecast in some areas on Friday, followed by sunny intervals and a few showers over the weekend.

Members of the public were reminded to drink plenty of water, take heat-protection measures and avoid vigorous outdoor activities. Anyone experiencing dizziness, headache, nausea or other symptoms of heat stress should rest and seek medical help promptly.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 今日繼續酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台料星期三大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約34度，新界部分地區仍然極端酷熱。
body: 香港天文台維持酷熱天氣警告生效，提醒市民留意持續高溫。
根據周二晚更新的預報，星期三大致天晴，早上最低氣溫約29度。日間市區最高氣溫約34度，新界再高兩至三度，部分地區仍然極端酷熱，吹和緩西至西南風。
天文台表示，一股西南氣流將逐漸影響廣東沿岸，本周後期高溫天氣稍為緩和。受高空擾動影響，星期五部分地區驟雨較多，周末則有幾陣驟雨及短暫陽光。
天文台呼籲市民多補充水分、做好防暑措施，並避免戶外劇烈運動。若出現頭暈、頭痛、噁心等不適徵狀，應立刻休息及盡快求醫。
